_comment: One place for the house rules. Scripts AND agents read this file. Change it here, nowhere else.
_books_help: Sportsbooks to use, in order of preference. Only these books' prices are collected, scored, shown, or used in parlays.
_min_price_help: Lowest American odds a bet may have to be shown or considered. 100 = plus-money only (+100 and longer). Minus prices are still read for the OTHER side of a pair so no-vig math works, but are never shown or recommended.
